name: chautauqua-backend
description: Lambda functions for Chautauqua calendar generation

scripts.build: npm run test && npm run build:prod
scripts.build:prod: npx esbuild src/handlers/calendarHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/calendarHandler.js --external:aws-sdk --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb --external:ical-generator --external:date-fns --external:cheerio --external:axios --external:uuid --external:node-fetch && npx esbuild src/handlers/adminHandler.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --outfile=dist/adminHandler.js --external:aws-sdk --external:@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb --external:@aws-sdk/client-s3 --external:@aws-sdk/lib-dynamodb --external:googleapis --external:jsonwebtoken --external:node-fetch --external:uuid
scripts.deploy: npm run build && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json && aws lambda update-function-code --function-name chautauqua-calendar-generator --zip-file fileb://lambda-function.zip
scripts.package: npm run build:prod && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json node_modules/
scripts.package:lambda: npm run build:prod && zip -r lambda-function.zip dist/ package.json node_modules/
